description: Energías Renovables - Balance por radio censal de Energía derivada de la Biomasa WISDOM is a dataset listed in Argentine national open data portal (datos.gob.ar), an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaría de Energía. Análisis espacial de la producción y consumo de dendrocombustibles aplicando la metodología de Mapeo de Oferta y Demanda Integrada de Dendrocombustibles (Woodfuel Integrated Supply/Demand Overview Mapping). Coverage: Argentina. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaría de Energía. Its tags are Biomasa, Energías renovables, Información geográfica. It offers 22 resource(s) in CSV, SHP. The portal shows 2026-08-03 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ar-portal.
